queries.sql:
WITH plan_ent AS (
        SELECT dim_primary AS member, SUM(amount) AS plan_amount
        FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_PLAN_COMPOSED
        WHERE version_id = 2 AND period = '2026-09'
          AND 
      account_code IN (
        SELECT account_code FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT
        WHERE statement_section = 'Revenue'
      )
     
        GROUP BY dim_primary
      ),
      actual_ent AS (
        SELECT dim_primary AS member, SUM(mapped_amount) AS actual_amount
        FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_MAPPED_ACTUALS
        WHERE period = '2026-09'
          AND plan_account_code IN (SELECT account_code FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT WHERE statement_section = 'Revenue')
          
        GROUP BY dim_primary
      ),
      sparkline_ent AS (
        SELECT dim_primary AS member, period, SUM(mapped_amount) AS amt
        FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.V_MAPPED_ACTUALS
        WHERE period >= DATEADD(MONTH, -5, TO_DATE('2026-09' || '-01'))::VARCHAR(7)
          AND period <= '2026-09'
          AND plan_account_code IN (SELECT account_code FROM SNOWCONSO_AXA_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT WHERE statement_section = 'Revenue')
          
        GROUP BY dim_primary, period
      )
      SELECT
        COALESCE(p.member, a.member) AS member,
        COALESCE(a.actual_amount, 0) AS actual,
        COALESCE(p.plan_amount, 0) AS plan,
        COALESCE(a.actual_amount, 0) - COALESCE(p.plan_amount, 0) AS delta,
        CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.plan_amount, 0) != 0
          THEN ((COALESCE(a.actual_amount, 0) - COALESCE(p.plan_amount, 0)) / ABS(p.plan_amount)) * 100
          ELSE 0 END AS delta_pct,
        COALESCE(a.actual_amount, 0) AS share_value
      FROM plan_ent p
      FULL OUTER JOIN actual_ent a ON p.member = a.member
      ORDER BY COALESCE(a.actual_amount, 0) DESC
